# MCP.Directory

> The MCP Server and Agent Skills Directory

MCP.Directory is the largest directory of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and AI agent skills. Find, evaluate, compare, and install 2,000+ MCP servers and 8,600+ agent skills across Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex CLI, Windsurf, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI, and Zed. Each listing includes one-click install configs, README docs, GitHub metrics, user reviews, and client compatibility info.

## Servers

- [All Servers](https://mcp.directory/servers): Browse and search 2,000+ MCP servers with category filters and sorting
- [Best MCP Servers](https://mcp.directory/best-mcp-servers): Curated top-rated servers
- [Awesome MCP Servers](https://mcp.directory/awesome-mcp-servers): Community-curated recommendations
- [Free MCP Servers](https://mcp.directory/free-mcp-servers): Open-source servers
- [Remote MCP Servers](https://mcp.directory/remote-mcp-servers): Cloud-hosted servers
- [Leaderboard](https://mcp.directory/servers/leaderboard): Ranked by views, installs, and GitHub stars
- [Categories](https://mcp.directory/categories): 27 categories — AI/ML, Database, Cloud, Browser Automation, Web Search, and more
- [Collections](https://mcp.directory/collections): Editorially curated server bundles
- [Compare](https://mcp.directory/compare): Side-by-side server comparison with feature matrices

## Skills

- [All Skills](https://mcp.directory/skills): Browse 8,600+ agent skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and GitHub Copilot
- [Leaderboard](https://mcp.directory/skills/leaderboard): Ranked by downloads
- [Categories](https://mcp.directory/skills/categories): Skills by use case

- [Zed](https://mcp.directory/clients/zed): Zed editor setup

## Tools

- [Config Converter](https://mcp.directory/tools/mcp-config-converter): Convert MCP configs between client formats
- [Config Validators](https://mcp.directory/tools/cursor-mcp-config-validator): Validate MCP JSON configs — available for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code, Windsurf, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Cline

## API

- [GET /api/v1/servers](https://mcp.directory/api/v1/servers): List servers. Params: `q`, `category`, `limit` (max 100), `offset`
- [GET /api/v1/servers/{slug}/install-configs](https://mcp.directory/api/v1/servers/{slug}/install-configs): Install configs for a server
- [GET /api/v1/skills](https://mcp.directory/api/v1/skills): List skills
- [GET /api/v1/posts](https://mcp.directory/api/v1/posts): List published blog posts
- [Sitemap](https://mcp.directory/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap with all indexed pages
